title: One Body
description: A wobbly physics party game for up to 6 players: everyone controls one limb of the same floppy creature, and one limb is a secret traitor. Walk it past rubber ducks, a seesaw, a gusty fan and an angry goose to the cake before time runs out. Watch the slow-motion replay after every fall, call meetings and vote limbs off. Play with friends by room code, join Quick Play, or practice with bots.
